meta.parties: Segu Madar v. Howumma Et Al

rules.statement: A compromise by a guardian ad litem on behalf of a minor is not binding on the minor if it was entered into without special leave from the Court, even if the minor assented to it.
rules.supporting_quote: Where the guardian ad item of a Muslim widow, who was under age entered into a compromise on her behalf without the special leave of Court,- Held, that the compromise was not binding on her,, although she had given her assent to it.
